tools.name: search_simbad_catalog
tools.description: Run a bounded anonymous cone query against the official SIMBAD TAP astronomical object database. Returns a fixed ten-column projection, stable object identities, preserved nulls, exact raw-byte provenance, and canonical request/normalized hashes. SIMBAD is not a general survey catalogue.

center_ra_deg.description: ICRS right ascension in decimal degrees.

tools.name: analyze_astrometric_kinematics
tools.description: Deterministically derive total proper motion, naive inverse-parallax distance, and transverse velocity from a bounded measurement table. Preserves missing values, reconstructs proper-motion covariance from an optional SIMBAD-style error ellipse, propagates available uncertainties with a declared first-order delta method, and returns publication-table plus Vega-Lite FigureSpec payloads with content hashes. It performs no network or arbitrary code execution.

source_content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact source table or provider response from which these measurements were projected.

tools.name: analyze_light_curve_periodicity
tools.description: Run a deterministic weighted floating-mean generalized Lomb-Scargle analysis over an explicitly bounded irregular light curve. Preserves every nullable observation, resolves the declared weighting policy without imputation, emits the full finite frequency grid, sampling-window power, local peaks, best-fit folded residuals, publication tables, and a Vega-Lite FigureSpec with exact content hashes. It reports a Baluev analytic false-alarm upper bound and a Montgomery-O'Donoghue period standard-error estimate when numerically resolvable; these are model estimates rather than calibrated detection probabilities or confidence intervals, and a returned 0 is a numerical floor rather than exact certainty.

source_content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact source table or file from which the observations were projected.

time_system.description: Explicit astronomical time system for the numeric time column.

time_offset_days.description: Constant added to each non-null time only for exact publication metadata; the calculation uses time differences.

weighting.description: weighted excludes otherwise complete rows lacking positive standard errors; auto uses inverse-variance weights only when every otherwise complete row supplies one.

frequency_count.description: Number of inclusive linearly spaced frequencies between 1/maximum_period_days and 1/minimum_period_days.

tools.name: describe_astronomy_capabilities
tools.description: Return the exact SIMBAD provider allowlist, calculation contracts, bounded analysis guards, provenance hashes, and honest limitations for this plugin.
